summary.prose: The build adds two store reads and writes, fills the two lease stubs, then rewires the worker in three small steps: dispose keeps the presence row, the tick uses reclaim and takeOver instead of recoverDeadLease, and a closed window's head message is marked not delivered. Each store rule is one guarded transaction proved with two connections on one file; each worker rule is proved with fake timers and a fake process map. A last task pins the unchanged bound, lists the existing follow tests that carry the reload display, scores the Epic constraints, notes the HLD amendments to file, and records the two-window hand check.

tasks.title: Store: presenceOf read and markNotDeliveredIfHead
tasks.summary: In chat-queue-store.ts add presenceOf(windowKey) to ChatQueueLeases (a read returning the window's presence row, or undefined) and markNotDeliveredIfHead(seq) to ChatQueueStore: one IMMEDIATE transaction that re-reads the head with the existing LIVE_HEAD query (reused, not restated, so it cannot drift from head()) and, when the head's seq equals the given seq (state queued or retrying), sets state not-delivered with error 'its window was closed', clearing waiting_on; returns false otherwise. Both additive; no schema change.
acceptanceChecks: presenceOf returns pid, pidStartedAt and heartbeatAt for a window that wrote presence, and undefined for one that did not
markNotDeliveredIfHead marks the head and returns true; the next row becomes the head
a row acknowledged first by another connection is not marked and the call returns false
a retrying head is marked too

tests.name: chat-queue-store.test.ts: presenceOf returns the row, and undefined when there is none
chat-queue-store.test.ts: markNotDeliveredIfHead marks the head, the next row becomes the head, and a row acknowledged first by another connection is not marked
chat-queue-store.test.ts: markNotDeliveredIfHead marks a retrying head whose window closed and the next row becomes the head

tasks.title: Store: takeOver and reclaim transactions
tasks.summary: Replace the two stubs in chat-queue-store.ts. takeOver(claim, now, holderGone?) runs in one IMMEDIATE transaction: re-read the lease; refuse when none, when it is this exact claim's, or when holderGone is absent or false; take it when the lease's windowKey equals the claim's, or when now - heartbeat_at >= LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS; then finish the lease's message as failed ('the window closed during the turn'), delete the lease row. reclaim(claim, holderGone?) re-reads the lease and, for the same windowKey with holderGone true, rewrites pid and pid_started_at, refreshes heartbeat_at and keeps seq and cliPid. Add the optional holderGone argument to the interface types.
acceptanceChecks: a stale lease of another windowKey with holderGone true is taken after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS and not before, and its message is failed with a resend
a lease of the claim's own windowKey with holderGone true is taken at once
holderGone absent or false never takes a lease, however stale
two connections racing takeOver on the same stale lease: exactly one returns true
reclaim for the same windowKey rewrites pid and keeps seq and cliPid and does not fail the message; for another windowKey it returns false
a lease whose message row is gone is deleted and nothing else changes

tests.name: chat-queue-store.test.ts: takeOver takes a stale lease of another windowKey only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS and fails its message, and refuses when holderGone is false, absent or the heartbeat is fresh
chat-queue-store.test.ts: takeOver takes a lease of the claim's own windowKey at once when holderGone is true
chat-queue-store.test.ts: two connections racing takeOver on one stale lease, exactly one returns true
chat-queue-store.test.ts: reclaim rewrites pid and keeps seq and cliPid for the same windowKey, and refuses another windowKey

tasks.title: Worker: dispose keeps the presence row
tasks.summary: In chat-queue-worker.ts dispose() stops calling store.leave(claim), so a reloading window's presence row ages out over PRESENCE_GRACE_MS instead of vanishing. Keep the rest of dispose (finish and release when the lease is this window's and its CLI is gone). Invert the S001 assertion at chat-queue-worker.test.ts:151 ('presence removed') to 'presence kept'.
acceptanceChecks: after dispose the window's presence row is still there and windowAlive stays true until PRESENCE_GRACE_MS has passed
dispose with the turn's CLI still running leaves the lease; with the CLI gone it finishes and releases, as before
the S001 dispose test passes with its assertion inverted

tests.name: chat-queue-worker.test.ts: dispose leaves the presence row in place and windowAlive stays true until PRESENCE_GRACE_MS passes
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: the worker (the existing S001 test, its presence assertion inverted to presence kept)

tasks.title: Worker: lease rules replace recoverDeadLease
tasks.summary: Remove recoverDeadLease from the worker's tick and add the lease rules: for a lease that is not this claim's whose holder pid is gone, a same-windowKey lease whose CLI is alive is reclaim()ed and one whose CLI is gone is takeOver()n at once; another window's lease is takeOver()n only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS, passing a holderGone predicate built from deps.isAlive over the holder pid and the lease's CLI. Move the 97df9bf7 'worker recovery' test onto the new calls.
acceptanceChecks: a reloaded window (same key, new pid) with the old CLI alive reclaims the lease and the message is not failed
a reloaded window with the old CLI gone frees the lease at once and fails the message with a resend
another window's dead lease is freed only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS, and a heartbeating holder past LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS is never taken
a tick in a window running its own message does not touch the lease
the 97df9bf7 worker recovery test passes on the new calls

tests.name: chat-queue-worker.test.ts: worker recovery: a reloaded window reclaims a lease whose CLI lives and does not fail the message
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: worker recovery: a dead holder and dead CLI of another window is freed only after LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS and the next message runs
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: worker recovery: a holder that keeps heartbeating past LEASE_TAKEOVER_MS is never taken over

tasks.title: Worker: reclaimed-lease rule
tasks.summary: After a reclaim the window holds a lease for a turn it did not start. While current is undefined and the worker holds a reclaimed lease, heartbeat it on each tick and check isAlive(cliPid, cliStartedAt); when the CLI has exited, finish(seq, detached-ended) and release the lease so the next message runs. Keep a small 'reclaimed seq' marker in the worker, cleared when the lease is finished or lost.
acceptanceChecks: a reclaimed lease is heartbeated while the CLI lives, so no other window takes it over
when the surviving CLI exits the message is finished as detached-ended, the lease released and the next message runs
if the lease is lost to another window the worker clears its marker and stops heartbeating
the display of the reloaded turn is not changed (S001's followLiveTurn)

tests.name: chat-queue-worker.test.ts: a reclaimed lease is heartbeated while the CLI lives, then finished as detached-ended and released when the CLI exits, and the next message runs
chat-queue-worker.test.ts: a reclaimed lease lost to another window clears the marker and stops heartbeating

tasks.title: Worker: closed-window head rule
tasks.summary: In the worker's tick, when the head message belongs to another window and the lease is free, decide whether that window is closed: presenceOf(head.windowKey) exists with heartbeatAt older than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS and isAlive(presence.pid, presence.pidStartedAt) false, or it has no presence row and head.createdAt is older than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS. When closed, call markNotDeliveredIfHead(head.seq) so the queue moves on; a false return is ignored. Log the marking with the message key and window key.
acceptanceChecks: a head whose window stopped refreshing presence for more than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS with a dead pid is marked not-delivered and the next message runs
a window whose presence row is fresh, or whose pid is alive, is never marked
a head with no presence row younger than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS is not marked; an older one is
dispose-and-recreate of a worker with the same windowKey while a second window ticks does not get the head marked
a reload slower than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS ends as not-delivered with a resend and no row is lost
a retrying head of a closed window is marked too
mixed versions: a previous-plugin window's dispose deleting its presence row does not get a head younger than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS marked, and an older one is marked once

chat-queue-worker.test.ts: a head whose window has a fresh presence row or a live pid is never marked; no presence row and a message younger than PRESENCE_GRACE_MS is not marked

tasks.title: Bound, display half of ac3, amendments and hand check
tasks.summary: Pin ac5 with tests over the existing bound (enqueue and resendFrom refuse at QUEUE_RECORD_BOUND with FULL_NOTE and leave every row; submit at the bound returns ok:false reason full) without new production code. List the existing S001 tests that carry ac3's display half in the TESTS record (turn-lifecycle.test.ts follow tests and chat-panel.test.ts reload-follow tests). Score k1-k5 against the finished change in the BUILD summary. List the three HLD amendments the question resolutions chose (sc1 methodAdd markNotDeliveredIfHead; sc2 methodAdd presenceOf plus the takeOver holderGone and own-key rule; the HLD 'flush' wording) as to be filed for the owner's approval, and say in the BUILD summary whether they were filed; they are not code and do not block the code tasks. Run the hand check in two windows: reload mid-turn with the CLI alive, reload with queued messages while a second window ticks, and close a window with queued messages.
acceptanceChecks: enqueue and resendFrom at the bound are refused with FULL_NOTE and no row is lost
submit at the bound returns ok:false reason full
the TESTS record names the S001 follow tests for ac3's display half
the BUILD summary scores k1-k5 and states whether the three HLD amendments were filed
